149 likes, 0 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 22, 2026: "We often wait for someone or something outside us to make us feel better. But true upliftment begins from within.

Through our thoughts, choices and daily actions, we have the ability to change the way we experience life. Instead of constantly looking outward, pause and ask yourself: What can I do today to lift my own mind and spirit?

The first step towards a better state of mind begins with you.".

441 likes, 7 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 20, 2026: "It is easy to feel spiritual when life is quiet.

The deeper practice begins when responsibilities become heavy, people become difficult, and life does not go according to plan.

It is easy to run from responsibility. It is real yoga to stay, to hold it with steadiness, and to still find grace in it.

Yoga is not only about withdrawing from difficulty.
It is also about learning to remain balanced in the middle of it.

To do what needs to be done without resentment.
To stay steady without becoming rigid.

To carry responsibility without losing inner grace.
Sometimes, the situation itself becomes your practice.".

370 likes, 5 comments - theyogainstituteofficial on October 19, 2026: "Gussa aaye, darr lage ya bechaini ho sabse pehle kya badalta hai?

Hamari saans.

Woh chhoti ho jaati hai, tez ho jaati hai, aur mann aur bhi zyada ulajhne lagta hai.

Hum aksar samadhan bahar dhoondhte hain phone mein, distractions mein, ya kisi aur par apni pareshani nikaal kar.

Lekin kabhi-kabhi pehla kadam bahut simple hota hai:

Rukiye. Apni saans ko dekhiye. Teen gehri saansein lijiye.

Saans hamesha isi pal mein hoti hai. Aur jab dhyaan saans par aata hai, bhatakta hua mann bhi dheere-dheere vartamaan mein lautne lagta hai.

Agli baar koi mushkil aaye, pehle saans par laut aaiye.

Kyuki shanti kahin bahar nahi woh ek saans jitni kareeb hai. 🌿

#TheYogaInstitute #DrHansaji #Saans #Pranayama #BreathAwareness".

posts.meta_description:
570 likes, 5 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 18, 2026: "We often tell ourselves,
“I’ll start tomorrow.”
Tomorrow I’ll be calmer.
Tomorrow I’ll try again.
Tomorrow I’ll make a better choice.

But a new beginning does not always need a new day.

“Every single breath is a new beginning. You do not need tomorrow to start again  this breath is enough to give you a fresh start.”

The breath brings you back to the present.
And the present is the only place where change can actually begin.
So if the last moment was difficult, let it pass.
Take one conscious breath.
And begin again. 

#theyogainstitute #drhhansaji #bhakti #gratitude".

146 likes, 0 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 15, 2026: "Kabhi-kabhi hum kisi insaan ya ghatna ka sirf ek hissa dekhkar usi ko poora sach maan lete hain.

Jaise haathi ko chhoone wale chaar log har kisi ka anubhav alag tha, aur har kisi ko laga ki wahi sahi hai.

Lekin sach aksar hamare nazariye se bada hota hai.

Isliye jab kisi se mann-mutaav ho, ya lage ki saamne wala bilkul galat hai, ek pal ke liye ruk kar sochiye

Kya main poori tasveer dekh raha hoon?

Ho sakta hai saamne wala galat na ho. 
Ho sakta hai usne bas zindagi ka koi aur hissa dekha ho.

Nazariya badalta hai, toh samajh bhi badalti hai.".

422 likes, 3 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 14, 2026: "When the mind is restless, forcing it to become calm often creates even more resistance.

Instead of fighting every thought, begin with something simpler  your breath.
Slow it down.

Make it steady.
Notice it without rushing.

To steady a restless mind, do not fight it. First steady the breath the mind will follow on its own.”
The breath and mind are deeply connected. When breathing becomes calmer and more rhythmic, the mind often begins to settle too.

So the next time your thoughts feel scattered, don’t argue with them.
Come back to your breath. 

#theyogainstitute #drhhansaji #bhakti #gratitude".

240 likes, 6 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 13, 2026: "Shaadi karni chahiye ya nahi?

Is sawaal ka jawab sirf age, society ya pressure se decide nahi hona chahiye.

Is reel mein Dr. Hansaji Yogendra samjhati hain ki vivaah ek zimmedari aur commitment hai, aur shaadi tabhi meaningful hoti hai jab dono log usse samajhkar nibhane ke liye taiyaar hon.

Sirf “shaadi karni hai” sochna kaafi nahi.

Khud se poochhiye:

Kya main is rishte ko samajhne, sweekar karne aur nibhane ke liye taiyaar hoon?

Shaadi ek decision se zyada hai  ek jeevan-saathi ke saath samvedansheel, zimmedar aur sahyogi jeevan jeene ki taiyaari hai.".

1,824 likes, 10 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 12, 2026: "Bhakti does not always need a grand temple, elaborate ritual, or perfect setting.
Sometimes, it is simply a quiet moment of remembrance.

A sincere prayer.
A feeling of gratitude.
A heart that softens in silence.

Bhakti does not ask for grand temples or elaborate rituals. It quietly sits, waiting, even in the smallest, calmest corner of your heart.

Devotion becomes powerful not because of how grandly it is expressed, but because of how sincerely it is felt.

You may not always need to go somewhere to find Bhakti.
Sometimes, you only need to turn inward. 

#theyogainstitute #drhhansaji #bhakti #gratitu".
